description: `types`, `typings` and `main` are alternatives naming one root, not a set of roots. `layered` publishes `make` through its `typings`, and the `Inner` its return type is only imported there — a consumer cannot name it — so `Inner#run` gets no key and the entry claiming it colors nothing. Reading `main` as a second entry point would publish the implementation module's whole surface beside the declared one, and an entry would then color a member nobody can reach through the package.

diagnostics.message: Call to `run` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is declared without a body — an ambient declaration, a `.d.ts`, or a value known only by its function type — and no mark, manifest, overlay, override or baseline entry colors it, so it is assumed to throw. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@no-throw/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
